notes.title: Shooter's Island Patch 0.1.0.1
notes.notes:
Shooter's Island Patch 0.1.0.1 is live!

0.1.0.1 Patch Notes: 


Fixed Forest flick training bug 
Updated year on intro video
Fixed player stepping up onto range button platform
Reduced overall game file size


Let us know what bugs you encounter in our discord so we can patch them out. We have a list of known bugs there. Join our Discord here.
